verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own docs say it audits the knowledge base for gaps, outdated articles and quality issues (via its MCP server). Its bulk replay of historical tickets surfaces knowledge gaps tied to projected resolution quality, which links gaps to questions the agent would miss. However, nothing explicitly mentions detecting conflicting or contradictory content, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit detection of conflicting content, detail on how gaps are reported to ops leads, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the platform surfaces knowledge gaps and conflicting content that cause the agent to miss or fumble questions

citations.quote: Audit your entire knowledge base for gaps, outdated articles, and quality issues
